clientPathMapping.onlyInClient: This page is only available while the desktop app shows a server it manages.
clientPathMapping.noServer: This window is not showing a managed server right now — mappings belong to one.
clientPathMapping.title: Where {{name}}'s libraries are on this machine
clientPathMapping.description: The server names its files its own way; this machine may mount them somewhere else entirely. Nothing can work that out on its own, so until a library is listed here this computer refuses to open its files rather than guessing.
clientPathMapping.canRunHereTip: Anything not listed is still handled by the server, or refused as something this computer cannot do yet. Updating Bakabase on this computer adds to this list.
